subject.title: fix(docker): bound ACP bind droid CLI download with timeout

question: Should the Droid installer intentionally have fixed 30-second connection and 300-second transfer caps in addition to the existing configurable setup timeout?
rationale: Current main already prevents an indefinite setup hang, so accepting this patch would introduce a narrower, unconfigurable timing policy whose intended CI tradeoff requires owner judgment.

options.title: Close as redundant
options.body: Keep the existing configurable outer timeout as the sole setup deadline because it already covers the reported indefinite hang.

options.title: Derive a fast-fail budget
options.body: Retain a distinct curl limit only after deriving it from the existing setup budget and adding behavior coverage for stalled and slow successful downloads.

options.title: Accept the fixed cap
options.body: Land the hardcoded limits after an owner confirms that all supported Droid live-test environments must fail within these exact intervals.

recommendation.title: Close as redundant
recommendation.body: Keep the existing configurable outer timeout as the sole setup deadline because it already covers the reported indefinite hang.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns timing policy for the live Docker and package-acceptance tooling surface.
